title: Industry group TechNet files a comment with the US DHS urging the White House to withdraw its proposal to charge $103,265 for most new H-1B visa applications (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Industry group TechNet files a comment with the US DHS urging the White House to withdraw its proposal to charge $103,265 for most new H-1B visa applications — Clash over proposed DHS rule to charge $103,265 fee reignites spat over highly skilled immigration
